title: Residency audit exports and geo routing for Hosted API
creator: Maya Chen
description: Deliver a combined product and operational surface for: (1) pinning Hosted API traffic and stored request artifacts to customer-chosen geographies, (2) per-API-key retention controls with legal-hold semantics, and (3) automated auditable evidence exports for compliance teams. This ticket scopes the PM work: acceptance criteria, rollout strategy, and coordination with design and engineering to implement region routing, residency metadata, retention enforcement, and a scheduled evidence export pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Console and API allow creating/updating a residency policy tied to an API key or project with explicit allowed regions (region codes)
Requests from a pinned API key are routed only to instances in allowed regions; any fallback is recorded and surfaced in audit logs
Retention setting (days) attached to an API key/project is enforced by autoscheduled deletion and prevented during legal hold

Automated monthly evidence export generates a signed bundle containing routing logs, residency metadata, retention actions, and a machine-readable manifest; export stored to a customer-provided S3 or to a secured Redwood artifact store
Evidence export can be triggered on demand via Console and REST endpoint and includes a tamper-evident checksum and KMS-wrapped key metadata
Documentation and runbook created for security/compliance reviewers describing data flows, chain-of-custody, and verification steps
engineering_notes: Core infra work tracked in ENG-5043: add geo-routing header and enforcement hook in front proxy; ensure region affinity for KV cache and model replicas
Retention enforcement will be eventual consistent; deletion jobs should emit idempotent events with trace IDs for replay

Fallback behavior: if no capacity in allowed region the request should fail with 451-like error and create an incident event; alternate configurable behavior is to queue for delayed regional execution
Evidence export format: NDJSON logs + manifest.json + signed metadata. Use per-customer KMS wrapping and supply S3 presigned URL support
Need rate and cost estimate for running monthly exports for customers with large volumes; add telemetry in runtime to estimate export size before scheduling
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Alpha for internal Redwood tenants and 2 pilot customers (console + API flag) for region pinning and retention settings. Phase 2: Enable automated monthly export and on-demand export for pilot customers, iterate on performance. Phase 3: GA with docs, runbooks, and optional managed export to customer S3. Gate to GA: successful pilot exports, security review signoff, and SLA for export delivery time <= 72 hours for large exports.
audit_evidence_spec: Exports include (a) routing_log.ndjson with per-request region tag and trace id, (b) residency_policy.json capturing API-key binding and effective regions, (c) retention_actions.ndjson showing delete/purge events and legal-hold flags, (d) manifest.json with checksums and timestamps, and (e) signature.asc containing KMS-wrapped signature metadata. Exports are packaged as tar.gz and delivered via customer S3 presigned URL or Redwood secure endpoint. Export schedule configurable (monthly/quarterly) and ad-hoc via API. All export actions must be recorded in the audit log for review.
